signature: “MACHT [H and T superimposed] FRIEDRICH / EHE. IN. NURNB / 1743”; master’s mark, identical to 1741, floral pattern.
remarks: Garland has raised dots, Nuremberg style rim wire with leaf pattern; one flat bell stay identical to 17412; hinge with pin, probably replacement; repair in bell sec. Examined by author 15 Aug 02. Part of a set, with 17412 and 17433. Dérans 1995 mentions 3 trombones (descant or alto, tenor and bass) signed 1741 and 1743).” The same source mentions “1 original case for the trombone, brownpainted [sic] exterior and redpainted [sic] interior with blue velvet. The case is meant for 4 trombones, a whole family, but the smallest one is missing.”
